card.text: Explore Ymir, a moon of Saturn, through its source-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Ymir is a distant retrograde moon of Saturn. This triangular approximation uses published light-curve model dimensions with assumed polar caps. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Triangular shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate triangular shape from published 20, 24 and 25 km equatorial sides and an 8 km polar semiaxis. Polar caps and the initial meridian are assumed; the original inversion mesh is unavailable.
